source_authority_note: uni-goettingen.de fails looksOfficial() (no .edu/.ac./.gov suffix) — this is the institution's own official page. Needs the officialDomains-provenance fix documented in source-authority-gap.md, not a lowered evidence bar.
limitations: SCALE-AMBIGUITY: page states a bare overall score of 93 with no scale/date qualifier and no subtest minimums. 93/120 unambiguously reads as the legacy/comparable 0-120 overall scale (93 is not a possible score on the new 1-6 average scale effective 21 Jan 2026). Since only an overall threshold is given (no subtest minimums), this is not the Glasgow-style partially_unsatisfiable defect — ETS's comparable 0-120 overall score remains available on score reports through approximately January 2028. RECENCY RULE also applies: 'Successful completion of a test must not be more than three years prior to the date of your application for admission.' Per scalar-thresholds-are-not-enough.md, this requirement should evaluate to needs_manual_review rather than a confident scalar pass/fail.
researcher_notes: Page is attached to one specific M.A. programme (Faculty of Humanities) but the phrasing reads as a generic, reusable university test-equivalence module (UNIcert/NULTE/Cambridge/IELTS/TOEFL/Pearson at C1 and B2) rather than programme-bespoke content. Not independently confirmed to appear identically on other Göttingen programme pages within this research pass, so recorded as programme-specific per the one page actually fetched.
